static_traits.name: Zhang Ruisen
static_traits.family_status: 有5个孙辈,Living alone在偏远小木屋
static_traits.social_status: 与孙辈关系Good,但日常人际互动较少,尤其在夜晚常感到Loneliness
static_traits.medical_history: not yet接受过心理治疗,No major physical illness;Retired与配偶去世后曾有轻度Loneliness感
static_traits.language_features: 首次求助略紧张;表达清晰,合作度高;思路有条理;能识do not并讨论自身的消极思维模式;Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续相信'因为我独自住在小木屋,所以我会一直Loneliness',这一思维模式导致我感到Loneliness与悲伤.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这些Loneliness感正在影响我的心理健康和整体福祉,促使我现在寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 五年前配偶去世后,Loneliness感明显加剧;夜晚回到空荡的小木屋时最为强烈,逐渐形成'我会一直Loneliness'的信念.
Retired后日常社交频率减少,居住在偏远小木屋带来的地理隔离使Loneliness感随时间加重;此前主要通过钓鱼,划船以及Spending time with grandchildren来应对,但效果有限;not yet曾主动寻求心理治疗.

special_situations.event: At night, returning alone to a remote small cabin; after activities end, the house is silent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我独自住在偏远小木屋,就意味着我的Loneliness是永久且without法改变的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过白天外出钓鱼或乘船来分散注意力以逃避夜晚的Loneliness感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会永远一个人,have not出路

special_situations.event: 当天与外界几乎have not社交互动
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一天都have not与人互动,就证明我被孤立,without人可依
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitates to contact grandchildren to avoid adding to their burden, instead digesting emotions alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人愿意陪我,我只能自己熬过去

special_situations.event: Thinking about the spouse's death后的生活与当下的Living alone状态
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Losing a partner means I will permanently lose intimate companionship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用个人爱好(钓鱼,划船)Displacement对失去伴侣的悲伤与Loneliness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not可能再拥有亲密关系

special_situations.event: 居住环境偏远,出行与社交not便
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Living remotely is doomed to make it hard to build or maintain social connections
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尚not yet主动了解当地钓鱼群体或木工社群,主要以Being alone活动应对
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我have not社交机会,这里只会让我更Loneliness

core_conflict.wish: Longing for stable intimate companionship and emotional connection
core_conflict.fear: 害怕成为家人的负担;害怕without尽的Loneliness
defense_goal: Reduces dependence on others through self-restraint, avoiding proactively seeking help to maintain inner security
以环境与现实理由Interpretationnot寻求支持的选择,降低Being rejected或打扰他人的Sense of guilt

object_relations.object_representation: 亲人们很忙,支持有限(探望频率not高)

object_relations.self_representation: A grieving person who lost an intimate relationship
object_relations.object_representation: The environment is a cold, isolated space (remote small cabin)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing seeking more support from grandchildren or increasing social contact
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes proactively contacting others will trouble them, thus tending toward self-restraint
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气委婉,强调对方很忙且not应打扰;避免直接提出具体请求,use含糊表述与礼貌性的Self-denial来弱化求助.

manifestations: Widowed后Living alone在偏远小木屋,夜晚寂静时Loneliness感最强
社交频率低,与外界互动减少;在当天缺乏互动时Loneliness感更重
Hesitates to express himself to family and seek support, worried about becoming a burden
outcomes: 对not yet来社交可能性的悲观Anticipation
晚间日常受影响(Low mood,Decreased drive)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Hesitating to contact my grandchildren for fear of becoming a burden, suppressing the urge to seek help back into myself
通过Being alone活动(钓鱼,划船)来内部消化Loneliness与悲伤,而非外向寻求支持

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Overly cautious about seeking help, limits the frequency of interaction with family
Constrains expressing needs with the reason 'they are busy'

exception_events.target_problem: 在夜晚Being alone于小木屋时,来访者通常会陷入'我将永远Loneliness'的反刍思维并感到强烈的Loneliness与悲伤.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在与孙辈相聚的那天晚上,来访者have not像往常那样沉浸在'永远Loneliness'的念头中,而是感到开心,Loneliness感明显减轻.
exception_events.reason: not同支持:与家人互动带来情感连接;not同情境:当日有社交交流;做法not同:主动与家人相聚,获得积极体验.

positive_force: 与孙辈关系Good,存在情感支持来源
Has hobbies such as fishing, boating, and woodworking, which can serve as entry points for behavioral activation and social participation
Willing to seek help and change; positive attitude
能识do not并愿意挑战消极思维模式
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking,倾向于将Loneliness视为永久状态
过度概括与预测not yet来,降低对社交可能性的期待

Hesitates to seek support, worried about becoming a burden to family

target_behavior.behavior: 夜晚反复陷入'我会一直Loneliness'的消极反刍并体验显著的Loneliness与悲伤
antecedent: Quiet inside after returning to the remote cabin at night
Little interaction with others that day
Thinking about the spouse's death与当下Living alone状态
target_behavior.core_reason: Widowed与Retired后Reduced socializing,居住环境隔离,以及对Loneliness的灾难化与非黑即白认知导致的负性Automatic thoughts维持反刍.
target_behavior.function: 通过自我论断来获得'确定性',在短期内回避外向寻求支持的Anxiety与not确定;以反刍替代现实接触.
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness与悲伤加重,晚间Decreased quality of life,维持并Reinforcement'我注定一直Loneliness'的信念.
